## Clean Architecture

All code follows Clean Architecture — dependencies point inward. Layers: Entities → Use Cases → Interface Adapters → Frameworks & Drivers. Cross-boundary data uses DTOs, not entities.

## Security by Design

Security is a first-class constraint: (1) Validate all inputs at system boundaries — reject early, reject explicitly. (2) Principle of least privilege — grant minimal access for each operation. (3) Fail securely — default-denied access, explicit allow-lists. (4) Defense in depth — multiple independent checks, not a single gate. (5) No secrets in code — use env vars or config, never literals. (6) Immutable domain entities where possible. — see .opencode/rules/security.md

## Project Conventions

- Java 21 LTS / Spring Boot 4.1.0 — build with JDK 21 via Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw`)
- Entrypoint: `org.maglez.Main` — `@SpringBootApplication` with `GET /health`
- Test framework: JUnit 5 + Spring Boot Test
- Domain under `org.maglez.eop.*` — STRIDE categories, threat cards, privilege escalation
- All commit messages MUST start with `[EOP-NNN]` (Jira prefix) — see .opencode/rules/git-commits.md
- Agents defined in `.opencode/agents/` — multi-agent team with subagent mode

## API Design — Contract-First

- Contract-first: hand-author `docs/api/openapi.yml` before implementing endpoints
- URL pattern: `/api/v1/{resource}` with plural nouns
- Standard response codes: 200/201/204/400/400/404/409/422/500
- Pagination via Spring `Page<T>` on list endpoints
- `@Operation` and `@ApiResponse` on all controller methods — see `.opencode/rules/api-design.md`

## Error Handling — RFC 9457 Problem Details

- All API errors return `application/problem+json` per RFC 9457
- Single `@ControllerAdvice` — no per-controller exception handlers
- Domain exceptions in `org.maglez.eop.*` have zero Spring imports
- `@Valid` validation errors produce field-level problem details
- Every exception-to-HTTP mapping is unit-tested — see `.opencode/rules/error-handling.md`

## Observability & Logging

- SLF4J for all logging — never `System.out`/`System.err`
- Structured JSON via Logback in production
- MDC correlation ID from `X-Correlation-Id` header
- Audit-log game-affecting actions (card draws, privilege escalations)
- Never log PII, secrets, or full request bodies — see `.opencode/rules/observability.md`

## Build Quality Gates

- `mvn verify` must pass before merge — gate is enforced in CI
- Checkstyle (Google Java Style) — violations fail the build
- SpotBugs — high/medium severity findings fail the build
- JaCoCo — minimum 80% instruction / 70% branch coverage
- Maven Enforcer — JDK >= 21, dependency convergence, banned deps — see `.opencode/rules/build-quality.md`

## Configuration Management

- Externalised config in `application-{profile}.yml`, `@ConfigurationProperties` with `@Validated`
- Prefix custom properties with `eop.*` — never raw `@Value`
- Profile convention: `dev` (local), `test` (CI), `prod` (production)
- Secrets via `${VARIABLE_NAME}` in yml — never literals — see `.opencode/rules/configuration.md`

## Versioning & Changelog

- Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 — MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with `-SNAPSHOT` suffix during development
- `pom.xml` `<version>` is the single source of truth; git tags mirror without suffix
- `CHANGELOG.md` follows Keep a Changelog format — see ADR-007

## Resilience Patterns

- Resilience4j for external service calls: retry (max 3), circuit-breaker (50% threshold), time-limiter (5s)
- Annotate with `@Retry`, `@CircuitBreaker`, `@TimeLimiter` — never raw try-catch at call site
- Log circuit state transitions at `WARN` — see `.opencode/rules/resilience.md`

## Feature Flags

- `@ConditionalOnProperty` with `application.yml` toggles — no extra library
- Naming: `ff_{feature}_v{n}` — default OFF (opt-in, fail secure)
- Gate incomplete features behind flags to merge to `main` early
- Remove flag + conditional once feature is stable — see `.opencode/rules/feature-flags.md`

## Caching

- Spring Cache abstraction: `@Cacheable`, `@CacheEvict`, `@CachePut`
- Cache naming: `{domain}.{entity}.{operation}` — TTL default 60s
- `@CacheEvict` on writes for the affected region
- Never cache security-sensitive domain decisions — see `.opencode/rules/caching.md`

## Test Data Builders

- Use Builder pattern for domain entity creation in tests (not large constructor calls)
- Place builders in `src/test/java/org/maglez/eop/entity/` next to the entity under test — see `.opencode/rules/testing.md`

## Database Migrations — Liquibase

- All DDL and reference data DML go through Liquibase XML changelogs — never raw SQL or Hibernate DDL auto-generation
- Changelog master: `db/changelog/db.changelog-master.xml`; changesets in `db/changelog/changes/` with date-based filenames
- Each changeset must include a `<rollback>` block; never modify a merged changeset
- Hibernate `ddl-auto=validate` — Liquibase owns the schema, Hibernate only validates — see `.opencode/rules/database.md`

## Load Testing — k6 + InfluxDB + Grafana

- All load tests use k6 scripts in `test/k6/` with shared stages/thresholds from `config/options.js`
- SLOs: `p(95) < 200ms`, `max < 1000ms`, `error rate < 0.1%` — tests abort on breach when threshold has `abortOnFail: true`
- Default `BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080`; override via env var for staging/prod
- Monitoring stack: `docker compose up -d` starts InfluxDB (database `k6` on :8086) + Grafana (provisioned dashboard on :3000)
- k6 pushes to InfluxDB via `--out influxdb=...`; Grafana queries InfluxDB for historical trend visualisation — see `.opencode/rules/performance-testing.md`
